_comment: JEV (judge ensemble verdicts) config. VALUES BELOW ARE EXAMPLES (defaults, shown for reference) — the file ships with JEV OFF. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader. Precedence: built-in defaults < jev.json < JEV_* env vars < per-run override. Set enabled:true (or JEV_ENABLED=1) to turn JEV on deliberately.
_comment_enabled: Master toggle — ships OFF. Env override: JEV_ENABLED=1 (truthy: 1/true/yes/on; falsy: 0/false/no/off).
_comment_model: EXAMPLE model ref. Env override: JEV_MODEL.
_comment_timeoutMs: EXAMPLE per-call timeout in ms (positive integer). Env override: JEV_TIMEOUT_MS.
_comment_maxStateChars: EXAMPLE cap on serialized state chars sent for judgment. Env override: JEV_MAX_STATE_CHARS.

thresholds._comment: EXAMPLE probability thresholds in [0, 1], except contractScoreMin (finite number >= 0). Env overrides: JEV_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD, JEV_SEVERITY_UPGRADE_THRESHOLD, JEV_CONTRACT_SCORE_THRESHOLD, JEV_VERIFIABLE_THRESHOLD, JEV_RISKY_THRESHOLD, JEV_NEEDS_HUMAN_THRESHOLD.

budget._comment: EXAMPLE per-run call/token budgets (positive integers). Env overrides: JEV_MAX_CALLS_PER_RUN, JEV_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS_PER_RUN.

_comment_zeroDataRetention: Zero data retention is ON. When true, JEV calls must not retain payload data. Env override: JEV_ZERO_DATA_RETENTION=1. Remote egress is additionally gated per-run by data class: confidential/regulated payloads are never sent (public/internal only).
